answers.sql:
SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(aml.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT aml
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON aml.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON aml.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
AND b.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_disputes_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON d.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE d.BUS_DT_K = 20250831
  AND d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON d.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2026-08-31'
  AND d.DFLT_FLG = true
  AND c.IS_CURR = true;

SELECT CAL_YR_NBR, CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, AVG(AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fx.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY CAL_YR_NBR, CCY_CD1
ORDER BY currency_code;

WITH last_valuation_date AS (
  SELECT dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  ORDER BY dt_k DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT m.dsplY_nm AS market_name,
       SUM(f.mkt_val1_amt) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.mkt_k = m.mkt_k
JOIN last_valuation_date lvd ON f.bus_dt_k = lvd.dt_k
WHERE m.is_curr = TRUE
GROUP BY m.dsplY_nm
ORDER BY total_portfolio_valuation DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT BR.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN ATM
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR BR ON ATM.BR_K = BR.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT DT ON ATM.BUS_DT_K = DT.DT_K
WHERE DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND DT.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND BR.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY BR.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250630

SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fx.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE fx.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT dt.MTH_NBR AS month_number, COUNT(dsp.CD_DSPT_F_K) AS disputes_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY dt.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH cust_current AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
acct_txn_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN
  WHERE BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customers_with_no_txn_2025
FROM cust_current c
LEFT JOIN acct_txn_2025 t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED')::FLOAT * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_declined
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH auth
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON auth.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT cc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cc ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = cc.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON c.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND cc.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY cc.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints_count DESC;

SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(txn.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN AS txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL AS ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
AND txn.IS_RVRSL = false
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees_2025 DESC;

SELECT SUM(TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dsp.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT aml
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON aml.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON aml.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE aml.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND jur.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250831
AND DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(CAST(BUS_DT_K AS TEXT), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS year, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL chnl ON txn.CHNL_K = chnl.CHNL_K
WHERE chnl.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(CAST(BUS_DT_K AS TEXT), 'YYYYMMDD')) IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT
  lp.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
  SUM(lb.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D lb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD lp ON lb.LN_PRD_K = lp.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON lb.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY lp.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers_cross_border_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
  b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  atm.txn_count
FROM
  bank_dwh.D_BR b
JOIN (
  SELECT
    BR_K,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM
    bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY
    BR_K
) atm ON b.BR_K = atm.BR_K
WHERE
  b.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND atm.txn_count = (
    SELECT
      MAX(txn_count_sub)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count_sub
      FROM
        bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm_sub
      JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_sub ON atm_sub.BUS_DT_K = dt_sub.DT_K
      JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b_sub ON atm_sub.BR_K = b_sub.BR_K
      WHERE
        dt_sub.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
        AND b_sub.RGN_CD1 = b.RGN_CD1
      GROUP BY
        atm_sub.BR_K
    ) subquery
  )
ORDER BY
  b.RGN_CD1;

SELECT
  m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON f.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY
  total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH wire_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
  WHERE BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
),
atm_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN
  WHERE BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers_both_txn
FROM wire_customers w
JOIN atm_customers a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K
WHERE w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH CustomerLifetimeValue AS (
  SELECT
    c.BUS_ID AS customer_id,
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    MAX(pv.BUS_DT_K) AS last_valuation_date,
    MIN(c.CUST_SNC_DT) AS customer_since_date,
    MAX(pv.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS max_portfolio_value
  FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D pv
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON pv.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  GROUP BY c.BUS_ID, c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
),
CustomerLifetimeDuration AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    customer_segment,
    max_portfolio_value,
    last_valuation_date,
    customer_since_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(TO_DATE(CAST(last_valuation_date AS TEXT), 'YYYYMMDD'), customer_since_date)) AS lifetime_years
  FROM CustomerLifetimeValue
)
SELECT
  customer_segment,
  AVG(max_portfolio_value) AS avg_lifetime_value,
  AVG(lifetime_years) AS avg_lifetime_years
FROM CustomerLifetimeDuration
WHERE max_portfolio_value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_segment;

SELECT br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
       br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
       AVG(NULL) AS average_salary
FROM bank_dwh.D_EMPL empl
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON empl.EMPLY_NM = br.DSPLY_NM
WHERE empl.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY br.BUS_ID;

SELECT
  c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
  c.DSPLY_NM AS customer_name,
  cr.DSPLY_NM AS esg_rating_name,
  cr.DSC AS esg_rating_description
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D lb
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON lb.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_CR_RTG cr ON lb.CR_RTG_K = cr.CR_RTG_K
WHERE
  c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND cr.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY
  c.BUS_ID, c.DSPLY_NM, cr.DSPLY_NM, cr.DSC
ORDER BY
  c.BUS_ID;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p.PTY_CLSSF_CD1 = 'GENDER_MALE' THEN 'Male'
    WHEN p.PTY_CLSSF_CD1 = 'GENDER_FEMALE' THEN 'Female'
    ELSE 'Other/Unknown'
  END AS gender,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_PTY p ON c.BUS_ID = p.BUS_ID
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND p.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;
SELECT 'No data available' AS message;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH date_keys AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT IN ('2025-06-30', '2025-12-31')
),
balances AS (
  SELECT ACCT_K, BUS_DT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (SELECT DT_K FROM date_keys)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b1.ACCT_K) AS accounts_with_balance_drop
FROM balances b1
JOIN balances b2 ON b1.ACCT_K = b2.ACCT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON b1.BUS_DT_K = d1.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON b2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
WHERE d1.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
  AND d2.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
  AND b1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < b2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.9;

SELECT
  cc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
  AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fc.RSLTN_AT - fc.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) / 86400) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_CMPLT fc
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cc ON fc.CMPLT_CTG_K = cc.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fc.BUS_DT_K::text::date) = 2025
  AND fc.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
GROUP BY
  cc.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
  cc.DSPLY_NM;

WITH cust_versions AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, VRSN_NBR, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
prev_versions AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, VRSN_NBR, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = FALSE
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customers_with_segment_change
FROM cust_versions c
JOIN prev_versions p ON c.BUS_ID = p.BUS_ID AND c.VRSN_NBR = p.VRSN_NBR + 1
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> p.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dt.QTR_NBR) = 4
) sub;

WITH Disputes_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
WireTransfers_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers_no_wire_transfer
FROM Disputes_2025 d
LEFT JOIN WireTransfers_2025 w ON d.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
WHERE w.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH date_30_jun_2024 AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2024-06-30'
), date_30_jun_2025 AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
), loans_2024 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM date_30_jun_2024)
    AND DYS_PST_DUE = 0
), loans_2025 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM date_30_jun_2025)
    AND DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l24.LN_ID) AS loans_count
FROM loans_2024 l24
JOIN loans_2025 l25 ON l24.LN_ID = l25.LN_ID

WITH WireTransfers2025 AS (
  SELECT
    CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    ORGNL_AMT AS amount
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL
), RankedTransfers AS (
  SELECT
    currency_code,
    amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY amount) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn_desc,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code) AS cnt
  FROM WireTransfers2025
)
SELECT
  currency_code,
  CASE
    WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
      (SELECT amount FROM RankedTransfers rt2 WHERE rt2.currency_code = rt.currency_code AND rn_asc = (cnt + 1) / 2 LIMIT 1)
    ELSE
      ((SELECT amount FROM RankedTransfers rt2 WHERE rt2.currency_code = rt.currency_code AND rn_asc = cnt / 2 LIMIT 1) +
       (SELECT amount FROM RankedTransfers rt2 WHERE rt2.currency_code = rt.currency_code AND rn_asc = cnt / 2 + 1 LIMIT 1)) / 2
  END AS median_amount
FROM RankedTransfers rt
GROUP BY currency_code, cnt
ORDER BY currency_code;

WITH txn_2024 AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS txn_count_2024
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL chnl ON txn.CHNL_K = chnl.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE chnl.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
    AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2024
), txn_2025 AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS txn_count_2025
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL chnl ON txn.CHNL_K = chnl.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE chnl.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
    AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT 
  ((txn_2025.txn_count_2025::NUMERIC - txn_2024.txn_count_2024::NUMERIC) / txn_2024.txn_count_2024::NUMERIC) * 100 AS pct_growth
FROM txn_2024, txn_2025;

WITH last_snapshots AS (
  SELECT
    dt.MTH_NBR AS month,
    MAX(f.BUS_DT_K) AS last_bus_dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  ls.month,
  SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM last_snapshots ls
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON f.BUS_DT_K = ls.last_bus_dt_k
GROUP BY ls.month
ORDER BY ls.month;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS num_customers_with_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.CUST_SNC_DT) = 2025
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' BETWEEN EFF_FRM_DT AND COALESCE(EFF_TO_DT, '9999-12-31')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment

WITH WireTransfers2025 AS (
  SELECT
    f.CUST_K,
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CUST_K
),
CurrentCustomers AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
),
RankedCustomers AS (
  SELECT
    cc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
    cc.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
    wt.total_wire_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY wt.total_wire_amount DESC) AS rn
  FROM WireTransfers2025 wt
  JOIN CurrentCustomers cc ON wt.CUST_K = cc.CUST_K
)
SELECT segment_code, customer_business_id, total_wire_amount
FROM RankedCustomers
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_wire_amount DESC;

WITH total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
  WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_count) AS percentage_of_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
    COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
  ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR
),
running_totals AS (
  SELECT
    month_number,
    wire_transfer_count,
    SUM(wire_transfer_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_number) AS running_total
  FROM monthly_counts
)
SELECT * FROM running_totals;

WITH WireTransfers2025 AS (
  SELECT
    WR_TRF_F_K,
    BUS_DT_K,
    ORGNL_AMT,
    ORGNL_CCY_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
  WHERE BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
),
FxRatesEUR AS (
  SELECT
    BUS_DT_K,
    CCY_CD1,
    MID_RT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D
  WHERE BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
    AND RT_TYP_CD1 = 'MID'
    AND CCY_CD1 != 'EUR'
)

SELECT
  SUM(CASE
        WHEN WT.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN WT.ORGNL_AMT
        ELSE WT.ORGNL_AMT / FX.MID_RT
      END) AS total_wire_transfer_amount_eur
FROM WireTransfers2025 WT
LEFT JOIN FxRatesEUR FX
  ON WT.BUS_DT_K = FX.BUS_DT_K
  AND WT.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = FX.CCY_CD1
WHERE WT.ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL
;

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR AS month,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS declined_share_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY declined_share_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  F_WR_TRF.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(F_WR_TRF.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
WHERE
  D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  F_WR_TRF.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
  total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;

SELECT
  ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  COUNT(txn.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE
  dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
  transaction_count DESC;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(a.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_disputes_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON d.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE dt.DT_K = 20250831
  AND d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS DEFAULTING_CLIENTS
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20260831
AND DFLT_FLG = TRUE
AND CUST_K IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  FX.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  AVG(FX.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate_2025
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D FX
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_DT DT ON FX.BUS_DT_K = DT.DT_K
WHERE
  DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  FX.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
  FX.CCY_CD1;

WITH year_2025_dates AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
latest_valuation_per_market AS (
  SELECT
    MKT_K,
    MAX(BUS_DT_K) AS latest_bus_dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (SELECT DT_K FROM year_2025_dates)
  GROUP BY MKT_K
)
SELECT
  m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
  SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM latest_valuation_per_market lv
JOIN bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f ON lv.MKT_K = f.MKT_K AND lv.latest_bus_dt_k = f.BUS_DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON lv.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_portfolio_valuation DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT BR.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN ATM
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR BR ON ATM.BR_K = BR.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT DT ON ATM.BUS_DT_K = DT.DT_K
WHERE DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND DT.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND BR.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY BR.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250630

SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fx.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE fx.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT dt.MTH_NBR AS month_number, COUNT(*) AS disputes_raised
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY dt.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customers_with_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH auth
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON auth.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  cc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
  COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cc ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = cc.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON c.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY cc.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints_count DESC;

SELECT
  ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  SUM(fee.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN fee
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON fee.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fee.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
AND fee.FEE_AMT > 0
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees_2025 DESC;

SELECT SUM(TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dsp.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.DTCTN_AT) = 2025
  AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250831
AND DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT
  d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
  COUNT(f_acct_txn.acct_txn_f_k) AS transaction_count
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f_acct_txn
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_CHNL d_chnl ON f_acct_txn.chnl_k = d_chnl.chnl_k
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_acct_txn.bus_dt_k = d_dt.dt_k
WHERE
  d_chnl.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
  AND d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY
  d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY
  d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH max_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(BUS_DT_K) AS max_bus_dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K <= 20251231
)
SELECT
  p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
  SUM(b.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D b
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON b.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
JOIN max_date md ON b.BUS_DT_K = md.max_bus_dt_k
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE;

WITH RankedBranches AS (
  SELECT
    b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_transaction_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) DESC) AS rn
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND b.IS_CURR = TRUE
  GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, atm_transaction_count
FROM RankedBranches
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_card_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON f.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_card_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY
  total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  WR_TRF.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(WR_TRF.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF WR_TRF
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_DT DT ON WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = DT.DT_K
WHERE
  DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  WR_TRF.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
  WR_TRF.CCY_CD1;

WITH wire_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
  WHERE BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
),
atm_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN
  WHERE BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
JOIN wire_customers w ON d.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
JOIN atm_customers a ON d.CUST_K = a.CUST_K
WHERE d.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, AVG(ESTMT_ASSTS_AMT) AS avg_customer_lifetime_value
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
       br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
       AVG(CAST(empl.DSC AS NUMERIC)) AS avg_salary
FROM bank_dwh.D_EMPL empl
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON empl.EMPLY_NM = br.BUS_ID
WHERE empl.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY br.BUS_ID;

SELECT
  c.BUS_ID AS borrower_business_id,
  c.DSPLY_NM AS borrower_name,
  r.DSPLY_NM AS esg_rating,
  r.DSC AS esg_rating_description
FROM
  bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_CR_RTG r ON c.BUS_ID = r.BUS_ID
WHERE
  c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND r.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_TYP_CD = 'CORPORATE'
ORDER BY
  c.BUS_ID;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p.PTY_CLSSF_CD1 = 'FEMALE' THEN 'Female'
    WHEN p.PTY_CLSSF_CD1 = 'MALE' THEN 'Male'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS gender,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_PTY p ON c.BUS_ID = p.BUS_ID
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND p.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY gender;

SELECT
  AVG(CASE
    WHEN STSFC_SCR_VAL1 ~ '^\d+$' THEN CAST(STSFC_SCR_VAL1 AS INTEGER)
    ELSE NULL
  END) AS avg_satisfaction_score_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC fci
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fci.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND STSFC_SCR_VAL1 IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 END) AS weekend_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 END) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH balances AS (
  SELECT
    ACCT_K,
    BUS_DT_K,
    CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
    (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'),
    (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31')
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b1.ACCT_K) AS accounts_with_balance_drop
FROM balances b1
JOIN balances b2 ON b1.ACCT_K = b2.ACCT_K
WHERE b1.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30')
  AND b2.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31')
  AND b2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < b1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.9;

SELECT
  cc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
  AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fc.RSLTN_AT - fc.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) / 86400) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT fc
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cc ON fc.CMPLT_CTG_K = cc.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fc.BUS_DT_K::text::date) = 2025
  AND fc.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
GROUP BY cc.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY cc.DSPLY_NM;

WITH cust_versions AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, VRSN_NBR, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
prev_versions AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, VRSN_NBR, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = FALSE
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customers_with_segment_change
FROM cust_versions c
JOIN prev_versions p ON c.BUS_ID = p.BUS_ID AND c.VRSN_NBR = p.VRSN_NBR + 1
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> p.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txn_quarters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    f.CUST_K,
    d.QTR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
quarters_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT QTR_NBR FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
cust_quarter_counts AS (
  SELECT
    CUST_K,
    COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) AS quarters_active
  FROM txn_quarters
  GROUP BY CUST_K
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM cust_quarter_counts cq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON cq.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
WHERE cq.quarters_active = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quarters_2025);

WITH disputes_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wires_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes_2025 d
LEFT JOIN wires_2025 w ON d.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
WHERE w.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH zero_dpd_20240630 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20240630
    AND DYS_PST_DUE = 0
),
more_than_30_dpd_20250630 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250630
    AND DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT z.LN_ID) AS loans_count
FROM zero_dpd_20240630 z
JOIN more_than_30_dpd_20250630 m ON z.LN_ID = m.LN_ID;

WITH WireTransfers2025 AS (
  SELECT
    CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    ORGNL_AMT AS amount
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL
),
RankedTransfers AS (
  SELECT
    currency_code,
    amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY amount) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn_desc,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code) AS cnt
  FROM WireTransfers2025
)
SELECT
  currency_code,
  CASE
    WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
      (SELECT amount FROM RankedTransfers rt2 WHERE rt2.currency_code = rt.currency_code AND rt2.rn_asc = (cnt + 1) / 2)
    ELSE
      ((SELECT amount FROM RankedTransfers rt2 WHERE rt2.currency_code = rt.currency_code AND rt2.rn_asc = cnt / 2) +
       (SELECT amount FROM RankedTransfers rt2 WHERE rt2.currency_code = rt.currency_code AND rt2.rn_asc = cnt / 2 + 1)) / 2
  END AS median_amount
FROM RankedTransfers rt
GROUP BY currency_code, cnt
ORDER BY currency_code;

WITH txn_counts AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT
  ((SELECT txn_count FROM txn_counts WHERE year = 2025)::NUMERIC / NULLIF((SELECT txn_count FROM txn_counts WHERE year = 2024), 0) - 1) * 100 AS pct_growth
;

WITH last_snapshots AS (
  SELECT
    dt.MTH_NBR AS month,
    MAX(dt.CAL_DT) AS last_snap_date
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  ls.month,
  SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM last_snapshots ls
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dt.CAL_DT = ls.last_snap_date
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
GROUP BY ls.month
ORDER BY ls.month;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS num_customers_with_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.CUST_SNC_DT) = 2025
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' BETWEEN EFF_FRM_DT AND COALESCE(EFF_TO_DT, '9999-12-31')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment

WITH WireTransfers2025 AS (
  SELECT
    CUST_K,
    SUM(STLM_AMT) AS TotalWireAmount
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
  WHERE STLM_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
  GROUP BY CUST_K
),
RankedCustomers AS (
  SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS SegmentCode,
    c.BUS_ID AS CustomerBusinessId,
    wt.TotalWireAmount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY wt.TotalWireAmount DESC) AS Rank
  FROM WireTransfers2025 wt
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON wt.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
  SegmentCode,
  CustomerBusinessId,
  TotalWireAmount
FROM RankedCustomers
WHERE Rank <= 3
ORDER BY SegmentCode, TotalWireAmount DESC;

WITH total_2025 AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  COUNT(*) * 100.0 / t.total_count AS percentage_of_total
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
CROSS JOIN
  total_2025 t
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  f.CCY_CD1, t.total_count
ORDER BY
  percentage_of_total DESC;

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    dt.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
    COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
  ORDER BY dt.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  month_number,
  wire_transfer_count,
  SUM(wire_transfer_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_number) AS running_total
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY month_number;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN f.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN f.ORGNL_AMT ELSE f.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT END) AS total_eur_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx ON f.CCY_CD1 = fx.CCY_CD1 AND f.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT dt.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN auth.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS declined_share_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH auth
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON auth.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY declined_share_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  F_WR_TRF.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(F_WR_TRF.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
WHERE
  D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  F_WR_TRF.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
  total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;

SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR, ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(txn.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR, ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(aml.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS aml_alerts_raised
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT aml
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON aml.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON aml.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts_raised DESC;

SELECT br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_disputes_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
WHERE dlq.BUS_DT_K = 20250831
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH last_august_day AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE MTH_NM = 'August' AND IS_MTH_END = true
  ORDER BY CAL_YR_NBR DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
WHERE DFLT_FLG = true
  AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM last_august_day)
  AND CUST_K IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  FX.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  AVG(FX.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate_2025
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D FX
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_DT DT ON FX.BUS_DT_K = DT.DT_K
WHERE
  DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  FX.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
  FX.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
  m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
  SUM(p.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D p
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON p.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON p.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fact
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR branch ON fact.BR_K = branch.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT date_dim ON fact.BUS_DT_K = date_dim.DT_K
WHERE date_dim.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND date_dim.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND branch.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250630

SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fx.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE fx.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NM = 'December';

SELECT dt.MTH_NBR AS month_number, COUNT(dsp.CD_DSPT_F_K) AS disputes_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY dt.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS num_customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH auth
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON auth.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  cc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
  COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cc ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = cc.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON c.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND cc.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY cc.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints_count DESC;

SELECT
  ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  SUM(txn.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees_2025 DESC;

SELECT SUM(TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dsp.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT aml
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON aml.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
WHERE aml.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM aml.BUS_DT_K::text::date) = 2025
  AND jur.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250831
AND DYS_PST_DUE > 90

SELECT
  d_dt.cal_yr_nbr AS year,
  COUNT(f_acct_txn.acct_txn_f_k) AS transaction_count
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f_acct_txn
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_CHNL d_chnl ON f_acct_txn.chnl_k = d_chnl.chnl_k
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_acct_txn.bus_dt_k = d_dt.dt_k
WHERE
  d_chnl.dsply_nm ILIKE '%mobile app%'
  AND d_dt.cal_yr_nbr IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY
  d_dt.cal_yr_nbr
ORDER BY
  d_dt.cal_yr_nbr;

WITH max_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K AS max_dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
),
loan_balances AS (
  SELECT LN_PRD_K, OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT max_dt_k FROM max_date)
),
loan_products AS (
  SELECT LN_PRD_K, DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT lp.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(lb.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM loan_balances lb
JOIN loan_products lp ON lb.LN_PRD_K = lp.LN_PRD_K
GROUP BY lp.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers_cross_border_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
AND f.BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231;

WITH atm_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
    b.BR_K,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_transaction_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND b.IS_CURR = TRUE
  GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, atm_transaction_count
FROM (
  SELECT region_code, branch_name, atm_transaction_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM atm_counts
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
  M.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
  SUM(A.STLM_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH A
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_MRCH M ON A.MRCH_K = M.MRCH_K
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_DT D ON A.BUS_DT_K = D.DT_K
WHERE
  D.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  M.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY
  total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH wire_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
  WHERE BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
),
atm_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN
  WHERE BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM wire_customers w
JOIN atm_customers a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K
WHERE w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH LatestCustomerVersion AS (
    SELECT BUS_ID, DSPLY_NM
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
CustomerInteractions AS (
    SELECT CUST_K, COUNT(*) AS InteractionCount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC
    GROUP BY CUST_K
),
CustomerCampaignResponses AS (
    SELECT CUST_K, COUNT(*) AS CampaignResponseCount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CUST_CMPG_RESP
    GROUP BY CUST_K
),
CustomerChurnLikelihood AS (
    SELECT
        c.CUST_K,
        ci.InteractionCount,
        cc.CampaignResponseCount
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    LEFT JOIN CustomerInteractions ci ON c.CUST_K = ci.CUST_K
    LEFT JOIN CustomerCampaignResponses cc ON c.CUST_K = cc.CUST_K
    WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
    lcv.BUS_ID AS CustomerBusinessID,
    lcv.DSPLY_NM AS CustomerName,
    ccl.InteractionCount,
    ccl.CampaignResponseCount
FROM CustomerChurnLikelihood ccl
JOIN LatestCustomerVersion lcv ON ccl.CUST_K = lcv.BUS_ID
ORDER BY ccl.InteractionCount ASC, ccl.CampaignResponseCount ASC
LIMIT 20;

WITH latest_valuation AS (
  SELECT
    CUST_K,
    MAX(BUS_DT_K) AS latest_bus_dt_k
  FROM
    bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D
  GROUP BY
    CUST_K
)
SELECT
  c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
  AVG(pv.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS avg_customer_lifetime_value
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D pv
JOIN
  latest_valuation lv ON pv.CUST_K = lv.CUST_K AND pv.BUS_DT_K = lv.latest_bus_dt_k
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON pv.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE
  c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND pv.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY
  c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT
  br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  AVG(CAST(empl.DSC AS NUMERIC)) AS avg_salary
FROM
  bank_dwh.D_EMPL empl
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_BR br ON empl.EMPLY_NM = br.BUS_ID
WHERE
  empl.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY
  br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
  br.BUS_ID;

SELECT
  c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
  c.DSPLY_NM AS customer_name,
  cr.DSPLY_NM AS esg_rating_name,
  cr.DSC AS esg_rating_description
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D lb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON lb.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CR_RTG cr ON lb.CR_RTG_K = cr.CR_RTG_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND cr.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'CORPORATE'
  AND lb.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT MAX(BUS_DT_K) FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D)
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID, c.DSPLY_NM, cr.DSPLY_NM, cr.DSC
ORDER BY c.BUS_ID;

SELECT
  AVG(CASE
    WHEN STSFC_SCR_VAL1 = 'Promoter' THEN 1
    WHEN STSFC_SCR_VAL1 = 'Detractor' THEN -1
    ELSE 0
  END) AS net_promoter_score_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_CUST_INTRC.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
AND STSFC_SCR_VAL1 IN ('Promoter', 'Detractor');

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH balances AS (
  SELECT
    ACCT_K,
    BUS_DT_K,
    CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
    (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'),
    (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31')
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts_with_balance_drop
FROM (
  SELECT
    b1.ACCT_K,
    b1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS balance_june,
    b2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS balance_december
  FROM balances b1
  JOIN balances b2 ON b1.ACCT_K = b2.ACCT_K
  WHERE b1.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30')
    AND b2.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31')
    AND b2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < b1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.9
) subquery;

SELECT
  cc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
  AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fc.RSLTN_AT - fc.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) / 86400) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT fc
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cc ON fc.CMPLT_CTG_K = cc.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fc.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND fc.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND fc.CNTCT_STRTD_AT IS NOT NULL
  AND fc.RSLTN_AT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cc.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY cc.DSPLY_NM;

WITH cust_versions AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, VRSN_NBR, CUST_SGMNT_CD1, IS_CURR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS NOT NULL
),
segment_changes AS (
  SELECT
    curr.BUS_ID
  FROM cust_versions curr
  JOIN cust_versions prev ON curr.BUS_ID = prev.BUS_ID AND curr.VRSN_NBR = prev.VRSN_NBR + 1
  WHERE curr.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND curr.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customers_with_segment_change
FROM segment_changes;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT cust.BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON txn.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND cust.IS_CURR = TRUE
  GROUP BY cust.BUS_ID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dt.QTR_NBR) = 4
) sub;

WITH dispute_customers_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wire_transfer_customers_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dsp.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM dispute_customers_2025 dsp
LEFT JOIN wire_transfer_customers_2025 wr ON dsp.CUST_K = wr.CUST_K
WHERE wr.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH date_20240630 AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2024-06-30'
),
date_20250630 AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
),
loan_status_20240630 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID, DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM date_20240630)
),
loan_status_20250630 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID, DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM date_20250630)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l24.LN_ID) AS loans_count
FROM loan_status_20240630 l24
JOIN loan_status_20250630 l25 ON l24.LN_ID = l25.LN_ID
WHERE l24.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND l25.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

WITH WireTransfers2025 AS (
  SELECT
    CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    ORGNL_AMT AS amount
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL
),
RankedTransfers AS (
  SELECT
    currency_code,
    amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY amount) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn_desc,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code) AS cnt
  FROM WireTransfers2025
),
Medians AS (
  SELECT
    currency_code,
    cnt,
    CASE
      WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = (cnt + 1) / 2 THEN amount END)
      ELSE
        AVG(CASE WHEN rn_asc IN (cnt / 2, cnt / 2 + 1) THEN amount END)
    END AS median_amount
  FROM RankedTransfers
  GROUP BY currency_code, cnt
)
SELECT currency_code, median_amount
FROM Medians
ORDER BY currency_code;

WITH txn_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT
  ((SELECT txn_count FROM txn_counts WHERE year = 2025)::FLOAT / 
   (SELECT txn_count FROM txn_counts WHERE year = 2024) - 1) * 100 AS pct_growth
;

WITH month_end_dates AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT, MTH_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND IS_MTH_END = TRUE
)

SELECT
  med.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM month_end_dates med
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON f.BUS_DT_K = med.DT_K
GROUP BY med.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY med.MTH_NBR;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS num_customers_with_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.CUST_SNC_DT) = 2025
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' BETWEEN EFF_FRM_DT AND COALESCE(EFF_TO_DT, '9999-12-31')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment;

WITH WireTransferTotals AS (
  SELECT
    f.CUST_K,
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS TotalWireTransferAmount
  FROM
    bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY
    f.CUST_K
),
CurrentCustomers AS (
  SELECT
    CUST_K,
    BUS_ID,
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM
    bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE
    IS_CURR = TRUE
),
RankedCustomers AS (
  SELECT
    cc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS SegmentCode,
    cc.BUS_ID AS CustomerBusinessId,
    wtt.TotalWireTransferAmount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY wtt.TotalWireTransferAmount DESC) AS Rank
  FROM
    WireTransferTotals wtt
    JOIN CurrentCustomers cc ON wtt.CUST_K = cc.CUST_K
)
SELECT
  SegmentCode,
  CustomerBusinessId,
  TotalWireTransferAmount
FROM
  RankedCustomers
WHERE
  Rank <= 3
ORDER BY
  SegmentCode,
  TotalWireTransferAmount DESC;

WITH total_2025 AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr_trf
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  wr_trf.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  COUNT(*) * 100.0 / total_2025.total_count AS percentage_of_total
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr_trf
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  CROSS JOIN total_2025
WHERE
  dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  wr_trf.CCY_CD1,
  total_2025.total_count
ORDER BY
  percentage_of_total DESC;

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    dt.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
    COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
  ORDER BY dt.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  month_number,
  wire_transfer_count,
  SUM(wire_transfer_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_number) AS running_total
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY month_number;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN WT.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN WT.ORGNL_AMT ELSE WT.ORGNL_AMT / FX.MID_RT END) AS total_amount_eur
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF WT
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D FX ON WT.BUS_DT_K = FX.BUS_DT_K AND WT.CCY_CD1 = FX.CCY_CD1
WHERE WT.BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
AND (WT.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' OR FX.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR')
AND FX.RT_TYP_CD1 = 'MID';

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) AS declined_share_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY declined_share_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
  f.CCY_CD1;
